integrity: Source-equation provenance and general decomposition are explicitly attributed. All numerical claims are covered by an exact finite-field checker and a written mathematical argument. Independent audit and independent validation have not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact results concern a specified six-rational-branch characteristic-seven curve and all 32 coefficient-marked quadratic descents, not all Humbert–Edge curves, or 32 isomorphism classes. General geometric and Jacobian decomposition results are prior literature. Historical indexed and nonindexed arithmetic computations could overlap. Finite enumeration alone does not prove the all-extension claim; the proof uses cohomological character decomposition.
title: The thirty-two quadratic descents of a six-branch Humbert–Edge curve over \(\mathbf F_7\)
